footnote_text: Represents the number of shares of common stock, which were 100% vested upon grant, to be delivered upon settlement of restricted stock unit award under the Reporting Person's executive chair offer letter on the designated deferred settlement date. The restricted stock units will be settled in one lump sum on the first trading day during calendar year 2027 as of which (A) the lock-up period applicable under the Reporting Person's lock-up agreement with the underwriters of the Issuer's initial public offering has expired or terminated and (B) the Reporting Person is permitted to sell shares of Common Stock in the open market under the Issuer's insider trading policy, but in all cases no later than December 31, 2027.
